blocks.text: Dekha gaya hai ke jin nuclei ka atomic number 82 se zyada ho woh qudrati taur par unstable hote hain aur khud ba khud radiations kharij karte hain. Aise nuclei ko radioactive kehte hain aur radiation ke is ikhraaj ko natural (qudrati) radioactivity. Yeh radiations teen qism ki hain: α-particles, β-particles aur γ-radiations. Unstable isotopes lab mein nuclear reactions se masnoo'i (artificial) taur par bhi banaye ja sakte hain: kisi stable element par neutrons, protons, alpha particles ya gamma rays jaise zyada energy wale zarre maare jayein to woh unstable ho kar radiation nikalne lagta hai. Ise artificial radioactivity kehte hain, aur radioactive isotopes ko radioisotopes ya radionuclides.

Electric field mein se guzarne par α, β aur γ alag alag raste lete hain (Fig. 12.4). α-particles negative plate ki taraf mudte hain, yani un par positive charge hai. α-particles bohat tez nikalte hain, aam taur par roshni ki speed ke chand fi sad (few percent), magar bhaari hone ki wajah se hawa mein sirf chand centimetre tak ja pate hain. β-particles positive plate ki taraf mudte hain, yani un par negative charge hai. β ka mudna α se zyada hai, jo sabit karta hai ke β, α se halke hain. β-particles tez chalte electrons hain jin ki speed roshni ki speed ke 0.9995 tak hoti hai. γ-radiations field se bina mude guzar jati hain, yani un par charge nahi. γ-radiations photons se bani electromagnetic radiation hain; yeh roshni ki speed se chalti hain, in ki penetrating power (cheez mein ghusne ki taqat) sab se zyada aur ionization power (atoms ko ion banane ki taqat) sab se kam hai.

blocks.alt: Radioactive maadda lead ke block mein ek khaane (cavity) ke sire par rakha hai. Is ki radiation ek shua (beam) ban kar nikalti hai aur do charged plates ke darmiyan se guzarti hai, oopar + aur neeche -. Plates ke baad beam teen hisson mein bant jati hai: beta rays + plate ki taraf zyada murti hain, gamma rays seedhi jati hain aur alpha rays - plate ki taraf thora murti hain; teeno photographic plate tak pohanchti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: Teen radioactive radiations, alpha, beta aur gamma (kitab ki Figure 12.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: lead block, radioactive substance, electrically charged plates, photographic plate, beta rays, gamma rays aur alpha rays. Beta ka rasta naranji, gamma ka jamni aur alpha ka hara hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Lead ka block radiation ko har taraf se rokta hai, is liye radiation sirf khaane ke munh se ek seedhi beam ban kar nikalti hai. Charged plates ke darmiyan beta particles manfi (negative) hone ki wajah se + plate ki taraf murte hain, alpha particles musbat (positive) hone ki wajah se - plate ki taraf murte hain, aur gamma rays par koi charge nahi, is liye woh seedhi jati hain. Beta ka mor (deflection) alpha se kahin zyada hai kyun ke beta (electron) bohat halka hai aur alpha bhaari. Photographic plate par teen alag nishan is baat ka saboot hain ke radiation teen qism ki hai.
Nucleus se α-particles, β-particles aur γ-radiations nikalne ke amal ko α-decay, β-decay aur γ-decay kehte hain. Neeche in ka bayan hai.
Alpha Decay

Kitab ke mutabiq jab nucleus mein protons ki dhakel (electrostatic repulsion) strong nuclear force ki kashish se zyada ho jaye to nucleus unstable ho kar alpha particles nikalta hai. (Asal mein alpha nikalne wale nuclei bhaari hote hain aur un mein neutrons protons se zyada hote hain, maslan radium-226 mein 88 protons aur 138 neutrons; masla bohat se protons ki dhakel ka hai.) α-particle helium (He) ka nucleus hai: 2 protons aur 2 neutrons. Yani α-decay mein nucleus 2 protons aur 2 neutrons khota hai: atomic number Z do kam aur mass number A chaar kam ho jata hai. Aam shakal:

Yahan ᴬ_Z X parent (asal) nucleus hai jo daughter (naye) nucleus ᴬ⁻⁴_(Z−2) X mein badalta hai, aur ⁴₂He alpha particle hai (kitab daughter ko bhi X likhti hai, halanke yeh naya element hai). Tajurbe se pata hai ke α-decay mein nucleons ki tadaad (A) aur electric charge dono barqarar rehte hain. Misal:
Radium-226 (²²⁶₈₈Ra) ek alpha particle nikal kar radon-222 (²²²₈₆Rn) ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Parent nucleus radium-226 (A = 226, Z = 88) nucleons ke guchhe ki shakal mein hai. Is se ek dashed teer chhote alpha particle, helium-4 (A = 4, Z = 2), tak jata hai aur doosra dashed teer neeche daughter nucleus radon-222 (A = 222, Z = 86) tak.
blocks.caption: Radium-226 ka alpha decay: parent nucleus, alpha particle aur daughter nucleus radon-222 (kitab mein Equation 12.3 ke saath bane be-unwan khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Radium-226 ka nucleus apne andar se 2 protons aur 2 neutrons ka ek guchha, yaani alpha particle (helium-4), bahar phenkta hai. Peeche jo nucleus bachta hai woh radon-222 hai: mass number 226 - 4 = 222 aur atomic number 88 - 2 = 86. Dono teeron ke numbers jor kar dekhein: 222 + 4 = 226 aur 86 + 2 = 88, yaani nucleons ki tadaad aur charge dono baqi (conserve) rehte hain.

Is reaction mein daughter nucleus (²²²₈₆Rn) parent nucleus (²²⁶₈₈Ra) se mukhtalif element hai. Ek element ka doosre mein badalna transmutation kehlata hai. Tajurbe se pata hai ke parent nucleus ka mass daughter nucleus aur α-particle ke kul mass se zyada hota hai. Is liye decay ke baad bani cheezon ki kul mass-energy (E = mc²) asal nuclide se kam hoti hai. Mass-energy ka yeh farq disintegration energy Q, ya decay ki Q-value, kehlata hai; yahi energy alpha particle aur daughter ko kinetic energy ki shakal mein milti hai.
Beta Decay
β-decay do qism ka hai: beta-minus decay aur beta-plus decay.
(i) β⁻-Decay

Jin nuclides mein neutron-to-proton ratio (N/P) bohat zyada ho, woh β⁻-decay karte hain. β-particles atom ke bahar ghoomne wale (orbital) electrons nahi; yeh nikalne ke waqt nucleus ke andar bante hain. Is amal mein nucleus ka ek neutron toot kar proton aur electron ban jata hai, aur saath ek aur zarra, antineutrino, nikalta hai jo neutrino ka anti-particle hai. Neutrino ki alamat Greek harf ν (nu) aur antineutrino ki ν̄ hai. Amal yeh hai:

Ek neutron proton ban jata hai aur charge barqarar rakhne ke liye ek electron nikalta hai; inhein beta particles kehte hain, aur yeh orbital electrons se bilkul alag pehchane nahi ja sakte. Neutrino aur antineutrino dono par charge zero aur mass bohat kam hai, is liye maadde se guzarte hue inhein dekhna bohat mushkil hai. β-particle nikalne se koi nucleon kam nahi hota: mass number A wahi rehta hai aur atomic number Z ek barh jata hai. Aam shakal:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke 'nucleons ki kul tadaad A wahi rehti hai magar mass number Z badalta hai'. Yahan lafz ghalat hai: A mass number hai aur Z atomic number. Beta-minus decay mein mass number A wahi rehta hai aur atomic number Z ek barh jata hai.

blocks.text_alt: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z+1) X + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄

blocks.text: Is se saaf hai ke atomic number Z wala parent element atomic number (Z + 1) wale element mein badal jata hai. Misal: thorium ka ek unstable isotope beta nikal kar protactinium ban jata hai (aam misal ²³⁴₉₀Th → ²³⁴₉₁Pa; kitab baen taraf sirf A aur Z likhti hai):

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Neutrino ka khayal sab se pehle Wolfgang Pauli ne 1930 mein pesh kiya taa ke beta-minus aur beta-plus decays mein energy ki conservation poori ho. Kitab ke mutabiq 1953 mein F. Reines aur C. L. Cowan ne ise ek taqatwar nuclear reactor mein pakra (un ka pakka tajurba 1956 mein shaya hua). Is daryaft par F. Reines ko 1995 mein Nobel Prize mila.
(ii) β⁺-Decay

Kuch nuclides mein neutron-to-proton ratio (N/P) stable rehne ke liye bohat kam hota hai; yeh electron ki jagah positron nikalte hain. Positron (e⁺) ka mass electron jitna magar charge positive hai; yeh electron ka anti-particle hai. Is amal mein nucleus ka ek proton neutron aur positron ban jata hai, aur saath ek neutrino nikalta hai. Aam shakal:

blocks.text_alt: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z−1) X + ⁰₊₁e + ν

blocks.text: Misal: neon positron aur neutrino nikal kar fluorine ban jata hai (kitab mein 'Flourine' chhapa hai):
Energy of Alpha and Beta Particles in Radioactive Decay

Kisi ek radionuclide ke α-decay aur β-decay, dono mein har dafa utni hi energy nikalti hai. Kisi radionuclide ke α-decay mein har α-particle ki kinetic energy bilkul tay-shuda (sharply defined) hoti hai. α-particles ki tadaad ko kinetic energy ke muqable mein graph par banayein to alag alag spikes (lakeerein) aati hain (Fig. 12.5). Yani α-particles ki energies discrete (alag alag, tay-shuda) hain.

blocks.alt: Alpha particles ki tadaad (N) aur kinetic energy (eV) ka graph. Kham (curve) ki bajaye is mein mukhtalif oonchai ki chaar alag amoodi lakeerein (spikes) khaas energies par hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: Alpha particles ki alag alag (discrete) energy qeematein (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: β-decay mein energy β-particle aur antineutrino ke darmiyan har baar mukhtalif hisson mein bant-ti hai; dono ki energy ka jor hamesha wahi rehta hai. Is liye β-decay mein electron ya positron ki energy zero se le kar ek zyada se zyada qeemat tak kuch bhi ho sakti hai. β-particles ki tadaad ko kinetic energy ke muqable mein banayein to musalsal (continuous) curve banta hai (Fig. 12.6). Yani beta particles ki energies continuous range mein hain. Alpha aur beta dono mein momentum aur energy ki conservation lagu hai.

blocks.alt: Beta particles ki tadaad (N) aur kinetic energy (eV) ka graph. Ek hamwar musalsal kham amoodi mehwar (axis) par thora oopar se shuru hota hai, kam energy par chouti (peak) tak jata hai, phir girta hua sab se zyada energy par sifar tak pohanch jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Beta particles ka musalsal (continuous) spectrum (kitab ki Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono graphs ka muqabla karein. Figure 12.5 mein sirf chand khaas energies par alag lakeerein hain: alpha particles tay-shuda (discrete) energies ke saath nikalte hain, aur beech ki energies par koi alpha particle nahi milta. Figure 12.6 mein kham sifar se zyada se zyada energy tak bina toote chalta hai: beta decay mein energy beta particle aur antineutrino (ya neutrino) mein har baar mukhtalif hisson mein bant-ti hai, is liye beta particle ki energy is range mein kuch bhi ho sakti hai. Kham ka aakhri sira woh zyada se zyada energy hai jo beta particle ko tab milti hai jab neutrino ko taqreeban kuch nahi milta.
(iii) Gamma Radiation
Nucleus se γ-radiation ka nikalna aam taur par yun likha jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: ᴬ_Z X* → ᴬ_Z X + γ radiation

blocks.text: Yahan ᴬ_Z X* excited (zyada energy wala) nucleus aur ᴬ_Z X us ki ground state (sab se kam energy wali halat) hai; A aur Z nahi badalte, sirf zaid energy γ photon ki shakal mein nikal jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Ghaib zarra ya nucleus bhariye: (a) calcium-45 (Z = 20) → ? + e⁻ + ν̄; (b) excited copper-58 (Z = 29) → ? + gamma (short question 12.4). Uranium-238 alpha emitter aur polonium-218 (Z = 84) beta-minus emitter hai; daughters nikalein (numerical 12.1, 12.2).
blocks.explanation: (a) Beta-minus decay Z ek barhata aur A rakhta hai: scandium-45 (Z = 21). (b) Gamma decay kuch nahi badalta: zameeni halat mein copper-58 (Z = 29). Uranium-238 (Z = 92) 4 nucleons aur 2 protons khota hai: A = 234, Z = 90, thorium-234. Polonium-218 ek proton pata hai: A = 218, Z = 85, astatine-218.

blocks.prompt: Beta decay ka energy spectrum musalsal aur alpha decay ka alag alag kyun hai (short question 12.11; constructed response 12.1)? Positron ikhraaj mein neutrino ka nikalna kyun zaroori hai (short question 12.5)?
blocks.explanation: Alpha decay mein azaad energy sirf do jism baant-te hain, alpha particle aur daughter nucleus, to momentum ki baqa har ek ka hissa tay kar deti hai aur har alpha ki energy ek hoti hai. Beta decay mein teen jism baant-te hain, electron (ya positron), antineutrino (ya neutrino) aur daughter nucleus, aur taqseem har decay mein badalti hai, to beta particle sifar se zyada se zyada tak koi bhi energy rakh sakta hai. Neutrino ke baghair positron ikhraaj mein energy, momentum aur angular momentum (spin) barabar nahi hote; neutrino ghaib energy aur spin le jata hai aur lepton number baqi rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Natural radioactivity: Z 82 se zyada wale nuclei α, β aur γ nikalte hain; artificial radioactivity radioisotopes banati hai. Electric field mein α negative plate ki taraf thora, β positive plate ki taraf zyada mudta hai, γ bilkul nahi.

Alpha: Z − 2, A − 4 (²²⁶₈₈Ra → ²²²₈₆Rn + ⁴₂He); transmutation; Q-value. Beta-minus: n → p + e⁻ + ν̄, Z + 1. Beta-plus: Z − 1 (¹⁹₁₀Ne → ¹⁹₉F + e⁺ + ν). Gamma: X* → X + γ. Alpha energies discrete, beta continuous. Table 12.2 teenon ka muwazna.
